structure.description: FISETIO indoor rows are monthly museum observations; mus_ID is intended to align with the museum lookup ID, with museum/name providing a textual cross-check.
FISETIO outdoor rows are monthly park observations keyed conceptually by park_id and date.
TripAdvisor Transaction joins User on UserId, Item on AttractionId, and Mode on Transaction.VisitMode = Mode.VisitModeId.
TripAdvisor Item joins City on AttractionCityId = CityId and Type on AttractionTypeId; geographic lookups continue City→Country→Region→Continent through their integer IDs.
Country names/codes offer possible semantic alignment among country-level, passport, heritage, and exchange-rate objects, but labels require normalization and no exact cross-file key is declared.
The Airbnb listing collection is geographically separate from the FISETIO and TripAdvisor attraction collections and has no declared shared identifier.

uncertainties: Exchange-rate direction and base currency are not declared by the three-column source table.
Some FISETIO abbreviations and units, especially pcp and revs, are not fully defined in the tabular headers.
Country labels use inconsistent casing, whitespace, naming conventions, and code systems across files.
Sentinel lookup rows with id 0 and label '-' are present in the TripAdvisor workbooks.
annotation_notes: All ordinary tabular columns are listed separately; the supporting DOCX is covered as part of the FISETIO bundle without inferring document-only facts.
